answer: A bond of 36% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in mirror, and onyx reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 66 aliases, and each one needs its own funded ridge account. A farm of 2817 identities would post 553 proofs and burn roughly 74 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
